tagline: Local and remote terminals and desktops in one window
summary: Home provides a local Terminal and chat. Hosts connect over SSH and open remote Terminals, files, and desktop apps. Changes wait for approval, and STOP is always there.
feature.home.title: This computer
feature.home.desc: Home provides a local interactive Terminal, local files, and AI chat.
feature.hosts.title: Hosts
feature.hosts.desc: Multi-tab SSH. The host icon opens that machine’s desktop: files, processes, a browser on the host network, and a terminal.
feature.ai.title: AI
feature.ai.desc: Local chat can help with this computer; remote chat follows the active SSH host.
feature.safety.title: Approval and STOP
feature.safety.desc: Read-only work can run on its own. Changes wait for your approval. STOP ends the run, including external agents.
step.hosts.text: Connect an SSH host and open its remote Terminal or desktop.
